summary: replace options: owner, required path, regexp (MULTILINE but not DOTALL; negated sets still match newlines), and replace with backreferences; empty replace removes matches.
questions: Why does [^#] match across lines in my replace regex?
How do I use capture groups in the replacement?
How do I delete matching text with replace?
Does ^ match each line in replace's regexp?

answer_card.title: replace regexp and replacement
answer_card.answer_md:
- `path` (required)
- `regexp` (required): MULTILINE (`^`/`$` per line), not DOTALL. `[^#]` still matches newlines; use `[^#\n]`.
- `replace` (default empty = delete): backrefs `\1` or `\g<1>`
- In short-form (`k=v`) tasks, backslash-escape escapes.
